Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, support tooling such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow, and customer success platforms such as Gainsight or equivalent.
* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.
* Fluent English. French or Arabic is an advantage.

Education

* Degree in business, engineering, computer science or a related field. ITIL or customer success certification is a plus.

### **Job Title:** **Warehouse Manager**

**Department:** Operations
  
**Location:** NEP Middle East – Dubai, UAE  
**Reports to:** Head of Operations MEA  
**Direct Reports:** Warehouse Assistants, Drivers, Freelancers (as needed)

### **Role Overview:**

As **Warehouse Manager** at NEP Middle East, you will oversee the day-to-day operations of the warehouse to ensure efficient, accurate, and safe handling of broadcast equipment and materials. You will manage the dispatch, receipt, storage, and return processes, while coordinating closely with the technical and production teams to support the delivery of high-profile events and productions.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Warehouse Operations & Coordination**

* Supervise daily warehouse activities including equipment check-in/check-out, inventory movements, and preparation for live projects.
* Ensure all incoming and outgoing equipment is accurately scanned, recorded, cleaned, and stored.
* Coordinate loading/unloading, packing, and shipment schedules with internal teams and logistics providers.

**Inventory & Asset Management**

* Oversee inventory control processes including tagging, barcode scanning, and regular cycle counts.
* Maintain accurate stock levels and ensure proper documentation using internal systems (e.g., HERO, ClearCo, etc.).
* Identify and report damaged or missing equipment; coordinate repairs or replacements as necessary.

**Team Supervision & Safety**

* Supervise and schedule the warehouse team, including freelancers and drivers.
* Enforce safety procedures and cleanliness standards within the warehouse.
* Provide guidance and hands-on support for technical packing and operational best practices.

**Cross-Department Collaboration**

* Work closely with operations, engineering, and production teams to ensure equipment readiness and availability for events.
* Support equipment requests for last-minute changes and on-site needs.

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate documentation of equipment transfers, dispatch notes, delivery records, and internal forms.
* Provide weekly status reports to management, including inventory levels, issues, and recommendations.

### **Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Minimum 3–5 years of warehouse or logistics experience, with **previous experience in the broadcast industry being essential**.
* Strong understanding of warehouse workflows, inventory management systems, and broadcast equipment handling.
* Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and warehouse tracking tools.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.
* Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Proactive team player with strong leadership, interpersonal and problem-solving skills.
* Physically fit and capable of performing manual handling tasks when required.

### **Why Join NEP Middle East?**

NEP is a global leader in live and broadcast production services. As part of our warehouse team, you’ll support some of the biggest and most dynamic productions in the region. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a fast-paced, collaborative environment and grow your operational leadership career.

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager, MENA Supply Chain is the single-threaded owner of end-to-end logistics performance and build-out across the Middle East and North Africa region, with initial focus on the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). This role designs, launches, and scales the regional logistics network, ensuring best-in-class cost, service, and delivery speed.

Operating as a core member of the regional leadership team, this role is the primary partner to the COO in-region. It translates global logistics strategy into scalable, high-performing operations and shapes key decisions based on regional realities, including cross-border customs flows, Arabic labeling, cash on delivery, and seasonal demand peaks such as Ramadan, Eid, and White Friday.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, and team building during a critical scale-up phase.

**Job Expectations:**

### **Build and Own the MENA Supply Chain Setup**

  

* Lead the end-to-end setup of the MENA logistics network, including selection of the regional hub (for example a free zone warehouse in Dubai) and the set-up of an Arabic and bilingual labeling solution in the MENA warehouse.
* Define the flow model for the region: import and consolidation at the hub, in-country distribution, and cross-border linehaul to the other GCC markets and, over time, the wider MENA region.
* Ensure the initial setup is scalable, cost-efficient, and operationally robust.
* Ensure logistics is a proactive enabler of growth, not a constraint.

### **End-to-End Performance Ownership**

  

* Own regional logistics KPIs across (i) cost (transport, warehousing, handling, customs duties and fees), (ii) service levels (OTIF, delivery promise accuracy, first-attempt delivery, cash on delivery remittance accuracy), and (iii) speed (lead times, delivery SLAs by country and city tier).
* Drive trade-off decisions across transportation, warehousing, and inventory, including air versus sea inbound and hub versus in-country stock placement.
* Plan capacity and inventory for regional demand peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) and for summer heat constraints on temperature-sensitive products.
* Establish full visibility and control over performance drivers.

### **Strategic Partner to COO (Regional Translation and Feedback Loop)**

  

* Act as the go-to logistics counterpart to the COO in MENA.
* Translate global strategy into executable regional plans.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on (i) market constraints, (ii) performance gaps, and (iii) optimization opportunities.
* Proactively challenge and refine global assumptions based on MENA realities, such as address quality, last-mile variability, and payment preferences.

### **Customs, Compliance and Regulatory Coordination**

  

* Drive cross-functional coordination to ensure MENA regulatory requirements are met across logistics operations, including product registration and import approvals with the relevant authorities in each market (for example SFDA in Saudi Arabia and the competent health and standards authorities in the UAE), GCC and country-level customs procedures, and halal and conformity requirements where applicable.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Marketing, customs brokers, and external partners on Arabic labeling, documentation (certificates of origin, attestations, import permits), and market-specific requirements.
* Translate compliance needs into operational execution across warehouses, 3PLs, customs brokers, and distribution flows, including free zone and mainland transfers and the GCC customs transit process.
* Identify risks and dependencies, such as shipment holds, registration delays, and duty classification disputes, and drive resolution across stakeholders.

### **Team Build and Leadership**

  

* Act as logistics representative within the regional leadership team.
* Lead a lean, high-performing regional logistics team, including a 3PL /Warehouse Manager, a Transportation and Customs Manager, and an Inventory Planner, with the ability to build a multi-cultural team across the region.
* Coach the team on carrier, 3PL, and customs broker strategy and execution, and collaborate with global to ensure global strategy and guardrails are followed.

### **Continuous Optimization and Scale**

  

* Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements early.
* Optimize network design (warehouse footprint, in-country versus hub stock, routing, inventory placement), including the timing of a second node, for example in Saudi Arabia, as volumes grow.
* Optimize last-mile and cash on delivery operations, including carrier mix, delivery success rates, and returns handling.
* Lead regional logistics projects (process improvements, system enhancements).

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Required:

* Proven experience building or scaling logistics operations (warehouse, transport, and inventory) in the region.
* Strong hands-on experience with 3PLs, carrier networks, customs brokers, and multi-country GCC distribution, including cross-border trucking and free zone operations.
* Working knowledge of GCC customs procedures and import requirements for regulated consumer products (health, food, personal care).
* Experience with e-commerce last-mile, including cash on delivery and returns, is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and deeply operational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management across global and regional teams, and the cultural fluency to work with partners across different MENA markets.
* Data-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable making trade-offs.
* Fluent English is required. Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Equipment Knowledge:**

  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Experience Requirements:**

The role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with frequent travel to the hub warehouse and port areas (for example Jebel Ali) and regular travel to other markets in the region, in particular Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam).

**1. Team and quarterly planning**

* Lead five administrators: 1:1s, goals, feedback. Run hiring for approved positions and, when necessary, parting ways — the latter agreed with your manager.
* Organize work across time zones: open incidents are handed over in writing to a specific person, and inconvenient hours are shared fairly. Three time zones cover about 13 hours of the working day, but not 24/7: you decide what truly requires a night-time or weekend response.

* Prepare a monthly report for the area: service and support health, access status, subscription spend and optimization results, key risks and items that need a management decision.

**2. Identity and access reviews**

* The identity provider is the central point of access provisioning: SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, role-based groups, SCIM. Hiring, transfers and terminations are triggered from the HR system.
* You verify revocation in the application itself. Deactivating a user in the identity provider does not end active sessions or revoke API tokens, local accounts and guest access. Systems without SCIM have an owner for manual revocation, and you make sure it is done.
* Access review frequency depends on risk: privileged and financial systems quarterly, everything else every six months. The system owner decides on each access, revocation is confirmed in the target system, and every exception has a reason and an expiry date. Results are retained as audit evidence.

  MDM: encryption, updates, security policies, shipping a laptop to another country with zero-touch setup.
* Build self-service for developers: standard access is requested via chat or a ticket, approved by the resource owner and granted automatically for a limited time.
* Set support priorities: major outages and security incidents first, then requests that block teams from working.

* Maintain the SaaS registry: owner, cost, number of seats, actual usage, renewal date and the last day the order can still be changed.
* Review paid seats separately from access reviews. Once a month, reconcile paid seats against activity. Long inactivity is a reason to check with the owner, not to reclaim the seat automatically: there are break-glass accounts and tools that are only needed once a quarter.
* Plan each contract review backwards from the last day the order can be changed or the renewal cancelled. By that day, the volume is agreed, the negotiation position is ready and the vendor has been notified if required. Example: 80 editor seats are paid for, 30 are actively used — we go to the vendor with 35 and a question about the pricing tier.
* Find shadow IT through OAuth grants and corporate card spend. In corporate cloud accounts, analyze bill growth by account and service together with the resource owner. Measure savings against invoices, separating realized savings from those expected at the next renewal.

For you, AI is the normal way the whole team works. What we expect:

* Preparation of access reviews and license reviews: AI reconciles exports from the identity provider, the HR system and applications and produces a list of anomalies for an administrator to verify.

* Set the rules: what data may be shared with a model and where only a human makes the decision. AI does not grant privileged access or reset MFA: an administrator does that, verifying the employee's identity before any MFA reset.

* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP) and BIM Execution Plans (BEP) in strict compliance with ISO 19650 standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.

* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future IoT sensor data metadata placeholders within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.
* CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows
* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.

* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within Autodesk InfraWorks, Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.

* AI Tools, Scripting & Automations
* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit, Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement AI-driven design tools and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

+ Roads & Highways

+ Bridges and Structures
+ Utilities
+ Aviation
+ Smart Infrastructure Projects

* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.

* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.

We're looking for a highly driven, technically excellent security and infrastructure leader who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company. In this role, you will own how DT One's infrastructure is designed, secured and operated, from the network edge and cloud landing zone through to identity, endpoints and the security operations centre.
  
  

* Define and own the security strategy, reference architectures and multi-year roadmap, working with senior leadership; run security assessments and gap analyses across the business to prioritise the controls that matter most
* Act as security design authority, reviewing and approving the architecture of new products, platforms and partner integrations so that security is designed in from the start
* Own the cloud and infrastructure security posture on AWS (and any multi-cloud footprint), including landing zone design, guardrails, CSPM, CIS hardening and security Infrastructure as Code in Terraform
* Lead network and edge security, including WAF, DDoS protection, DNS, next-generation firewalls, micro-segmentation and network access control, and drive the move to zero-trust network access in place of legacy VPN
* Own identity and access management: identity architecture, SSO (SAML, OIDC), MFA and passwordless, Conditional Access, privileged access management, identity governance and automated joiner-mover-leaver processes
* Lead security operations and the SOC, including SIEM strategy and migration, log source onboarding, detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, ingestion cost optimisation, audit logging and incident response
* Run endpoint and vulnerability management across the estate, including EDR, MDM/MAM, patching, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing and remediation with engineering teams
* Lead PCI-DSS compliance and recertification, and align our controls to ISO 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls
* Lead the security workstream for audits, partner assessments, M&A and investor due diligence, and maintain clear security architecture documentation for executives, auditors and the Board
* Set governance for the safe use of AI and generative-AI services across the business, including technical controls on unapproved tools
* Own the infrastructure and security budget: build business cases for new controls and technologies, lead vendor selection and proofs of concept, and manage a multi-vendor environment
* Build, lead and develop a team across infrastructure security, IAM, security operations and SOC, including hiring, performance management and career development

**What we are looking for**

* 15+ years' experience across infrastructure, networking and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years leading security architecture, engineering or operations teams
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Experience in payments or fintech
* Proven track record of setting security strategy and reference architectures with a CISO or CTO, and acting as design authority for new platforms
* Track record of building infrastructure and security functions from the ground up, including standing up the full IT, network and security stack for a new business at pace
* Deep hands-on expertise in network and edge security (for example Cloudflare, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco), with a strong routing, switching and core network foundation
* Hands-on cloud security experience on AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including landing zones, CSPM and security Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
* Experience delivering zero-trust network access programmes (for example Zscaler ZPA) at scale
* Strong identity and privileged access experience, for example Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, PAM platforms such as One Identity Safeguard, and IGA platforms such as Saviynt
* Experience leading SOC teams and SIEM platforms (for example Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, IBM QRadar), including platform migrations and log ingestion cost optimisation
* Experience leading PCI-DSS certification and maintaining compliance through annual recertification
* Working knowledge of CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF and ISO 27001
* Experience owning budgets, running vendor selection and explaining risk and trade-offs clearly to senior business leaders, auditors and investors
* Expert-level professional certification such as CCIE, CISSP or equivalent; CEH or vendor security certifications are a plus
* Comfortable using AI-assisted engineering to deliver faster, and interested in the security of AI services

Canadian University Dubai (CUD) is seeking exceptional faculty at the ranks of Associate Professor in Cybersecurity and related disciplines to join School of Engineering, Applied Science, and Technology (SEAST).

**Qualifications**

Applicants must hold a PhD in Cybersecurity. Candidates should have a strong record of teaching, research, and industry engagement in Cybersecurity or AI applications in cybersecurity.

Proficiency in with Open Cybersecurity Tools. Candidates should demonstrate practical experience with widely used open-source cybersecurity tools and frameworks, such as:

* Experience using and teaching open-source penetration testing and security assessment tools from the OWASP ecosystem (e.g., OWASP ZAP, OWASP Dependency-Check, OWASP Juice Shop).
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning, web application security testing, and secure coding practices using OWASP tools and methodologies.
* Relevant professional certifications (e.g. Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) – by ISC2, Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) – by ISACA, Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) – by ISACA, Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) – by Offensive Security, GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC) – by Global Information Assurance Certification, GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) – by Global Information Assurance Certification or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) – by EC-Council) are preferred.

**Experience Requirements**

* Assistant Professor – Minimum 2 years of undergraduate teaching experience in a top 300 QS-ranked university, with curriculum development and graduation project supervision experience.
* Associate Professor – Minimum 5 years of undergraduate/graduate teaching experience in a top 500 QS-ranked university, with MSc/PhD supervision experience. Familiarity with ABET accreditation is preferred.

**Teaching Areas**

Teaching will span the key areas in Cybersecurity and general computing courses:

* Foundations of Computer Science, AI and Machine Learning, providing core principles and algorithms;
* Operating systems, data structure, data mining, algorithms and software paradigms, focusing on cutting-edge techniques, large language models and emerging models;
* Network Security, Cryptographic Algorithms, Software Vulnerability, Security Threats and Risk Analysis, Mobile and Wireless Security, and Penetration Testing and Ethical hacking; and
* Professional Practice and Research, fostering project management, industry engagement, and scholarly inquiry.

**Research Focus**

Successful candidates will drive high-impact research, producing 2–10 publications in reputable, peer-reviewed journals (preferably Q1/Q2 Scopus-indexed, commensurate with academic rank). Research should advance innovation in Computer Science, Applied Science and Cybersecurity while addressing global challenges through the following thematic areas:

* AI-based intrusion detection systems
* Malware detection and classification using machine learning
* Adversarial machine learning and AI security
* Automated threat intelligence and security analytics
* Behavioral anomaly detection in networks and systems
* AI Cybersecurity policy and ethics – shaping responsible innovation and governance frameworks.

* All research is expected to align with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly:

* SDG 3: Good Health and Well-Being
* SDG 4: Quality Education
* SDG 9: Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure
* SDG 11: Sustainable Cities and Communities
* SDG 13: Climate Action

* Serve as the program’s subject matter expert, supporting the Program Chair/Coordinator in operations and ensuring curriculum alignment with CUD, industry needs, and the latest developments in the field.
* Teach undergraduate and graduate courses in AI and related fields, ensuring engaging delivery, updated syllabi, and timely grading.
* Supervise student projects, internships, and theses, while advising students—especially those at academic risk.
* Contribute to curriculum design, course development, and continuous program improvement.
* Conduct research, publish in reputable journals, and engage with industry to advance applied AI practice.
* Participate in academic governance, accreditation processes, faculty meetings, and professional development.
Engage in community outreach, industry collaborations, and represent CUD at professional events.

**About The Role**
Establish and lead Powertech’s new Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul (MRO) business unit, servicing the P-series piston engines (10–200 HP class) operated by EDGE platform companies and regional and international UAV customers, and later other engine types in the portfolio (e.g., microjets).
  
  
The role starts as a build role — business case, project plan, statements of work, facility, approvals and team — and becomes an operating role with full P&L, budget and headcount accountability. It also owns the Abu Dhabi engine test facility as a shared service for MRO acceptance testing and product development testing.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Business Case & Stand-up**

* Business case — build and present the MRO business case (installed base, service offering, pricing, capex/opex, headcount, break-even, risks); own its delivery.
* Project plan & SOW — build the stand-up project plan and write the statements of work (facility fit-out, equipment and tooling, MRO/ERP software, subcontracts); run the project to plan.
* Facility & approvals — define and deliver the MRO facility, tooling and processes; obtain the applicable approvals (authorised service centre, AS9100/AS9110, CAR-145/Part-145 or military airworthiness as required).

**Business Unit P&L**

* P&L — own revenue, cost, margin and working capital; produce budget, forecasts and monthly reporting.
* Service offering — define and price repairs, overhauls, exchange pools, spares, long-term support agreements and field service; negotiate with customers alongside Commercial.
* Growth — develop the aftermarket with EDGE platform companies and regional/international operators; build business cases for MRO of other engine types.

**MRO Operations**

* Processes — establish work-scoping, inspection standards, repair schemes, build standards and release to service; maintain manuals with Engineering.
* Delivery — plan capacity and shifts; manage turnaround time, on-time delivery and first-time yield.
* Spares & field service — define spares provisioning and traceability; stand up field service and rapid-response support.

**Test Facility**

* Asset owner — own the engine test facility (test cells, dynamometers, DAQ, fuel and safety systems): availability, maintenance, calibration, upgrades and capex.
* Shared service — run acceptance and post-overhaul testing for MRO and development, endurance and qualification testing for the product programmes; agree priorities with Product Managers and Test & Development.
* Safety & operations — own SOPs, test-cell safety, operator authorisation, configuration control and test data integrity.

**Team**

* Hire & build — define the organisation and hire the team; transfer build, overhaul and test know-how from the Powertech Italy facility.
* Lead — set objectives, manage performance and develop people; safety-first, quality-first culture.

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Quality system — implement the MRO quality system (AS9100/AS9110) with Quality; own release documentation, records and traceability.
* HSE & compliance — own health, safety and environmental compliance for the workshop and test facility, and export-control compliance for parts and technical data.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Degree in Aerospace, Mechanical or Automotive Engineering, or equivalent technical qualification with substantial hands-on experience.
* 10+ years in engine/powertrain MRO, after-sales or test, including 5+ years leading a maintenance, overhaul or test operation with budget or P&L accountability.
* Experience standing up a new operation, facility or business line from business case to steady-state operation.
* Hands-on knowledge of piston engine build, overhaul and test.
* Experience under aviation maintenance approvals or equivalent quality systems (Part-145/CAR-145, AS9100/AS9110, military airworthiness).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* UAV/RPAS engine experience; 2-stroke, heavy-fuel and/or EFI engines; microjets.
* Defence/military customer environment; GCC market; test-cell design or commissioning.
* MRO/ERP system implementation; Lean/Six Sigma; PMP/PRINCE2; Italian or Arabic.

Technical Skills & Tools
  
  

* MRO processes (work-scoping, repair schemes, release to service) and reliability programmes (TBO, MTBUR, warranty).
* Engine test-cell infrastructure and operations (dynamometers, DAQ, fuel and safety systems); test data interpretation.
* Business-case and P&L modelling, budgeting, project management, SOW writing, supplier management; MRO/ERP systems.

Role summary

The Cafe Supervisor runs each shift at Escena Cafe so that every guest gets fast, consistent service and every shift closes with balanced cash, accurate stock and a clean, compliant kitchen and floor. You lead the baristas, servers and kitchen team on shift, act as the Cafe Manager's deputy, and are measured on the KPIs set out below.

Key responsibilitiesShift running

* Run the shift plan: assign stations, set break times and redeploy staff during peaks.
* Hold a 5-minute pre-shift briefing on specials, stock-outs, bookings and targets.
* Monitor ticket times and step in on the bar or floor when queues build.
* Complete the shift handover log before leaving.

Team leading

* Supervise baristas, servers and kitchen staff on shift, typically 4 to 8 people.
* Train new starters on recipes, service standards and the POS within their first 2 weeks.
* Give on-the-spot coaching and flag performance or attendance issues to the Cafe Manager.
* Help the Cafe Manager build the weekly rota and approve shift swaps.

Opening and closing

* Open and close the cafe using the opening and closing checklists, signed off every day.
* Check equipment (espresso machine, grinders, fridges, ovens) and log faults the same day.
* Make sure the cafe is ready for guests at the published opening time.
* Secure the premises, cash and alarm at close.

Cash and stock control

* Count floats, run end-of-day POS reports and reconcile cash and card takings.
* Approve voids, refunds and discounts within agreed limits.
* Run daily spot counts on high-value items (coffee, milk, dairy alternatives, pastries) and the weekly full stock count.
* Log all waste and place supplier orders against par levels.
* Receive deliveries and check quantity, quality and temperature against the invoice.

Food safety and hygiene

* Enforce Dubai Municipality food safety rules and the cafe's HACCP-based food safety plan.
* Complete temperature logs for fridges, freezers and deliveries every shift.
* Make sure every food handler holds a valid Dubai Municipality occupational health card and required food safety training.
* Enforce cleaning schedules, allergen controls, labelling and FIFO stock rotation.
* Lead the team during Dubai Municipality inspections and close any findings by the deadline given.

Customer service

* Set and model Escena's service standards on the floor.
* Handle complaints on the spot and log any that need follow-up.
* Monitor online reviews and delivery-app ratings with the Cafe Manager.
* Look after regulars and drive upselling of add-ons, pastries and retail items.

* Experience assessing project-based businesses, long-term contracts, commodity price exposure, reserve/resource-based assets, regulated businesses, and capital-intensive operating models.
* Ability to evaluate sector-specific risks and opportunities and articulate their impact on earnings, cash flows, valuation, and transaction structure.

* Present due diligence findings, key risks, and deal considerations confidently to senior management, investment teams, executive stakeholders, and investment committees.
* Facilitate discussions between multiple parties and drive alignment on key transaction matters in a professional and constructive manner.

* Build trusted relationships with clients, management teams, investors, and other transaction stakeholders.

**Position:** Café Operations Manager  
**Department:** Operations  
**Reports To:** Café Owner / Management

Job Summary

The Café Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the café, ensuring efficient service, proper inventory control, effective supplier coordination, staff performance, and accurate financial reporting. The role focuses on maintaining operational efficiency, controlling costs, and ensuring high standards of customer service.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Daily Operations & POS Management**

* Oversee daily café operations and ensure smooth workflow.
* Manage and monitor the Point of Sale (POS) system.
* Verify daily sales, cash transactions, and payment reconciliations.
* Ensure accurate recording of sales, discounts, refunds, and expenses.
* Resolve operational issues and maintain service quality.

**2. Inventory & Stock Control**

* Maintain and regularly update inventory lists.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment.
* Conduct weekly stock counts and monthly inventory reconciliation.
* Track product usage, wastage, expiry dates, and stock discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and minimize unnecessary costs.

**3. Supplier Management & Procurement**

* Coordinate with suppliers for café products, beverages, pastries, packaging, and other supplies.
* Place purchase orders and follow up on deliveries.
* Verify delivered quantities, product quality, and invoices.
* Maintain supplier records, price lists, and payment schedules.
* Monitor supplier performance and negotiate pricing when required.
* Ensure consistent product availability and supply continuity.

**4. Staff Management & Mentoring**

* Supervise café employees and coordinate daily responsibilities.
* Prepare staff schedules and monitor attendance and punctuality.
* Train, mentor, and support employees to improve performance.
* Ensure compliance with workplace policies, hygiene standards, and customer service expectations.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations and address staff concerns.
* Promote teamwork, accountability, and a positive working environment.

**5. Financial Monitoring & Reporting**

* Prepare daily sales summaries and cash reconciliation reports.
* Submit weekly operational reports covering sales, inventory, expenses, and staff performance.
* Monitor operating costs and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Perform monthly financial close-out procedures, including sales reconciliation, supplier invoices, inventory valuation, and expense verification.
* Prepare monthly financial summaries for management review.
* Coordinate with accounting personnel to ensure accurate financial records.

**6. Quality Control & Customer Satisfaction**

* Maintain consistent standards of product presentation and service.
* Monitor customer feedback and resolve complaints professionally.
* Ensure cleanliness, equipment maintenance, and operational readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.

Reporting Requirements

* **Daily:** POS reconciliation, sales verification, and operational monitoring.
* **Weekly:** Sales performance, inventory status, supplier updates, staff performance, and operational issues.
* **Monthly:** Financial close-out, expense summaries, inventory reconciliation, supplier payment tracking, and overall performance review.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Previous experience in café, retail, or hospitality operations management.
* Proficiency in POS systems and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong inventory control and supplier coordination skills.
* Basic accounting, budgeting, and financial reporting knowledge.
* Strong leadership, communication, and staff mentoring abilities.
* Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Sales performance and revenue growth.
* Inventory accuracy and wastage reduction.
* Supplier delivery reliability and cost control.
* Staff productivity and attendance.
* Accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting.
* Customer satisfaction and service quality.

**Scope of Position:** This role is focused on café operations, retail sales, staff supervision, supplier coordination, and financial administration. The café does not operate an in-house kitchen; therefore, food preparation, cooking, recipe development, and kitchen management are excluded from the position's responsibilities.

This version is suitable for a café such as Suhail Café, where products are sourced from external suppliers rather than prepared in an in-house kitchen. It can be used for recruitment, an employment contract attachment, or defining the manager's responsibilities and accountability.

CONSTRUCTION COMPANY | STATE OF QATAR

**1. Job Purpose**

The Quantity Surveyor (QS) is responsible for managing and monitoring all financial and contractual aspects of construction projects. The role ensures accurate measurement of construction works, cost estimation, preparation of Bills of Quantities (BOQ), progress payment applications, variation claims, subcontractor payments, and final accounts.

The QS works closely with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, Planning Engineer, Procurement Department, Finance Department, Consultants, Clients, and Subcontractors to ensure that projects are delivered within the approved budget and contractual requirements.

**2. Main Duties and ResponsibilitiesA. Pre-Contract / Tendering Responsibilities**

* Review tender documents, drawings, specifications, and contract requirements.
* Prepare detailed quantity take-offs and Bills of Quantities (BOQ).
* Prepare cost estimates, rate analysis, and tender pricing.
* Obtain quotations from suppliers and subcontractors.
* Evaluate and compare subcontractor and supplier quotations.
* Prepare tender clarifications and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Identify discrepancies, omissions, and potential cost risks in tender documents.
* Assist in preparing commercial and technical tender submissions.

**B. Post-Contract / Project Responsibilities**

* Monitor project costs against the approved budget.
* Measure and verify actual completed works at the project site.
* Prepare monthly Interim Payment Applications (IPA).
* Prepare and submit Progress Claims to the Client or Consultant.
* Review and verify subcontractors' payment applications and invoices.
* Prepare, evaluate, and submit Variation Orders (VOs).
* Monitor additional works, omissions, and changes in project scope.
* Maintain records of project quantities, costs, and financial commitments.
* Prepare monthly cost reports and cash flow forecasts.
* Coordinate with the site team to verify work progress and completed quantities.

**C. Contract Administration**

* Review contract agreements, conditions, and commercial requirements.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and submission deadlines.
* Prepare contractual letters, notices, and commercial correspondence.
* Follow up on pending approvals, variations, and payment certificates.
* Review contractual claims and supporting documentation.
* Assist in Extension of Time (EOT) and cost claim submissions.
* Maintain proper documentation of contractual correspondence and approvals.

**D. Subcontractor and Supplier Management**

* Prepare and review subcontract agreements.
* Evaluate subcontractor quotations and commercial proposals.
* Verify subcontractor progress claims and invoices.
* Monitor subcontractor work progress and payment status.
* Coordinate with Procurement regarding material costs and purchase orders.
* Negotiate rates and commercial terms with suppliers and subcontractors.
* Ensure that subcontractor payments are properly supported by approved documents.

**E. Final Account and Project Closing**

* Prepare and finalize the project's final account.
* Reconcile actual project costs against the approved budget.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and retention releases.
* Finalize subcontractor accounts.
* Prepare final variation statements and outstanding claims.
* Ensure all commercial documents are properly recorded and submitted.

****Overview****
Established by Emiri Decision No. 13 of 2022, the
**University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST)**
is Qatar’s first national university specializing in applied, technical and professional education, with more than 9,500 students in over 80 bachelor’s, master’s and diploma programs across five colleges. Its Applied Research and Graduate Studies (ARGS) division leads research around four pillars, including Sustainable Development, through an innovation-driven model that takes ideas from early-stage research to real-world deployment.
  
  
**About the Center of Excellence for Sustainability and Food Security**
It Is One Of UDST’s Interdisciplinary Centers Of Excellence, Which Brings Together Academia, Industry And Government To Address Two National Priorities, Environmental Sustainability And Food Resilience. Its Research Spans Across Four Themes:
  
  

* Crop Protection, Precision Agriculture and Plant Health: intelligent monitoring and pathogen surveillance for greenhouse and open-field systems.
* Sustainable Ecosystems, Environmental Resilience and Climate Action: circular resource management, biodiversity and climate adaptation.
* Smart Livestock Monitoring and Precision Animal Welfare: digital tools for healthier, more productive livestock systems.
* Food Security and Water Resources Management: water conservation, desalination, groundwater protection and efficient irrigation.

Qatar stands at the forefront of some of the most pressing sustainability challenges of our time: producing food in a hyper-arid environment, managing scarce freshwater resources and highly relying on import.
  
  
UDST’s Center of Excellence for Sustainability and Food Security turns these constraints into practical, science-driven solutions for farms, greenhouses and national decisionmakers.
  
  
We are looking for its Director: a research leader with the vision, credibility and energy to make the Center a regional reference point for applied research on food, water and environmental resilience in hot, arid climates.
  
  
**Why join us?**

* Impact you can see: a young Center with a national mandate, real momentum and the backing of university leadership.
* Support to succeed: research infrastructure, help in securing funding, and innovation pathways from intellectual property to incubation through ARGS.
* A great place to work: a multicultural community on a modern campus in Doha. UDST has been certified a Great Place to Work® four years running and was ranked among the Top 10 Best Workplaces in Qatar in 2026.
* An attractive package: our eligible employees enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, in accordance with applicable UDST policies. These benefits include:

+ Generous academic annual leave
+ Tax free salary
+ Fully furnished upmarket accommodation (inclusive of utilities: water & electricity)
+ Annual flights for spouse and 3 children (up to 18 years old)
+ Children’s education allowance
+ Relocation/Shipping allowance
+ Professional development opportunities
+ International health insurance
+ In-house immigration services (to help you through the residency process)
+ Full access to our recreational facilities
+ Research and professional development support

AECOM Buildings + Places is seeking an Operations Manager to support the day-to-day operational performance of our Markham and Mississauga business.

This is a hands-on leadership role focused on translating business priorities into consistent execution. The Operations Manager will work closely with local and regional leadership, project managers, technical leaders, project controls, finance, and other business functions to strengthen project performance, resource management, operational discipline, and overall business effectiveness. This role has been created as a replacement role.

The position will support both the technical practice and operational management of the Markham/Mississauga operation, with particular emphasis on project profitability, client satisfaction, effective project delivery, and efficient business operations.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Support the day-to-day operational management and performance of Buildings + Places in Markham and Mississauga.
* Work with leadership to implement business priorities and maintain consistent operational discipline across the local practice.
* Monitor project and business performance and identify areas requiring management attention or corrective action.
* Support project managers in maintaining strong financial performance, forecasting, cost control, profitability, and delivery discipline.
* Coordinate workload and resource planning to align available staff with current and anticipated project requirements.
* Monitor utilization, staffing requirements, and workload forecasts to identify capacity constraints, underutilization, and emerging resource needs.
* Work closely with project managers, technical leaders, project controls, and finance to improve visibility and accountability for project performance.
* Identify projects requiring additional management attention and coordinate appropriate support and corrective actions.
* Reinforce consistent project management, operational controls, reporting, and business processes.
* Support effective project delivery and client satisfaction by helping teams identify and address operational issues early.
* Facilitate collaboration between the Markham/Mississauga team and the broader Buildings + Places organization to access expertise and resources when required.
* Support business planning and execution of operational priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, reporting, efficiency, and accountability.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and disciplined project delivery.

 **Qualifications**

Minimum Requirements

* Bachelor's degree required + eight (8) years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education

* Demonstrated experience in operations, project delivery, project management, business management, project controls, or a related function within a project-based professional services environment.
* Experience supporting the financial and operational performance of projects or a portfolio of projects.
* Strong understanding of project financial management, forecasting, workload planning, resource management, and project delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with project managers, technical professionals, business leaders, and corporate support functions.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to identify operational issues, establish priorities, coordinate corrective actions, and follow issues through to resolution.
* Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and establish accountability across multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience within architecture, engineering, consulting, buildings, infrastructure, or a multidisciplinary professional services environment.
* Experience supporting the operations of an office, business unit, or portfolio of projects.
* Experience with project financial performance, resource forecasting, utilization management, and operational reporting.
* Experience supporting project managers in improving project execution and resolving performance challenges.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across technical disciplines and business functions.
* Experience implementing or improving operational processes, management controls, and performance reporting.
* Understanding of the commercial and operational drivers of a consulting and professional services business.

  
**Additional Information**

The Operations Manager will be a visible and engaged member of the Markham/Mississauga Buildings + Places team, providing practical operational support to project managers and technical leaders while reinforcing accountability for project performance and operational discipline.

The role will focus on identifying emerging issues, coordinating the appropriate people and resources, driving follow-through, and supporting leadership in maintaining consistent operational and project management practices across the business.

### **About Magma Math**

Magma is one of the world’s fastest-growing and most celebrated edtech companies, transforming math education through the power of AI. Our platform turns handwritten solutions into digital insights, empowering teachers to focus on creativity and deeper learning — while giving them real-time visibility into student progress.

The result? More inclusive, engaging, and effective math classrooms for all learners.

But we’re not just building better tools. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in global education: math underperformance. With 1 in 5 students globally struggling in math — a subject that forms the backbone of so many career paths — we believe the opportunity to improve outcomes at scale is massive.

We’re already the go-to solution in thousands of schools — and we’re just getting started. As we expand rapidly across the U.S. and Europe, we’re building a team as ambitious as our mission: to help millions of students unlock their full potential in math.

As the Customer Success Manager, you will oversee and nurture portfolio of Canadian board partners and play a powerful role in ensuring educators successfully implement and see continuous value from Magma Math. We're growing quickly across Ontario and the rest of Canada, so this is a big opportunity to play a critical role within Magma Math Canada.

Your primary mission is to build and grow relationships with math leadership and to onboard teachers, coaches, and school leaders and see through their long term success with Magma. As a CSM, you will be highly visible to schools and will communicate frequently with board stakeholders including administrators, coaches, curriculum directors, and teachers. You will work with coaches and teachers to ensure product adoption and best practices in the classroom, promoting exemplary mathematical instruction and discourse among teachers and students.

about this team
  
  
The lululemon cybersecurity team helps protect the trust our guests, employees, and partners place in us. We work across technology and the business to understand risk, build practical security capabilities, and enable teams to move quickly and responsibly. We are looking for a Director of Security Operations to lead our Security Incident Response Team (SIRT), Threat Intelligence, Security Observability, and Detection Engineering capabilities. This leader will build an operation that treats detections as software: versioned, tested, measurable, and continuously improved.
  
  
core responsibilities
  
  
You will lead a global team of security engineers, analysts, threat hunters, intelligence practitioners, and incident responders. You will set the strategy and operating model for detecting, investigating, and responding to threats across lululemon’s technology environment. You are as comfortable discussing telemetry and detection logic with engineers as you are explaining business impact and response decisions to executives. You know that effective security operations is not measured by how many alerts a team can generate. It is measured by how reliably we identify meaningful threats, respond to them, and improve the systems around us.
  
  
Lead incident response
  

* Own the SIRT strategy, incident response lifecycle, and operational readiness across cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, network, and application environments.
* Lead coordination during significant incidents, establishing clear decision-making, escalation, communications, and recovery processes.
* Partner with technology teams, Legal, Privacy, Communications, Risk, and other stakeholders to manage incidents and their business impact.
* Run exercises and post-incident reviews that result in owned, tracked improvements to detection, response, and resilience.
* Establish a sustainable global coverage model, including on-call and external partnerships where appropriate.

Build detection as code
  

* Set the direction for a detection engineering program that manages detection logic, queries, rules, and response workflows as version-controlled code.
* Establish engineering practices for peer review, automated testing, deployment, documentation, tuning, and retirement of detections.
* Use threat modeling, incident learnings, threat intelligence, and adversary behavior to prioritize detection coverage against meaningful risks.
* Validate detections continuously through simulation, replay, purple teaming, and other appropriate testing methods.
* Reduce alert fatigue by improving signal quality, enriching context, and automating repeatable work while retaining human judgment for consequential decisions.

Own security observability
  

* Define the telemetry strategy needed to investigate threats across identities, systems, applications, cloud services, and data flows.
* Partner with engineering and platform teams to build reliable, secure, and cost-conscious telemetry pipelines, including clear ownership, data quality, retention, and access controls.
* Identify and address visibility gaps, including those created by changes in infrastructure, SaaS adoption, and emerging technologies.
* Guide the evolution and consolidation of security operations tooling, including decisions about what to build, buy, retain, or retire.

Turn intelligence into action
  

* Lead a threat intelligence capability that identifies and communicates threats relevant to lululemon’s business, technology, and operating environment.
* Translate intelligence into prioritized detections, hunts, defensive improvements, and incident readiness.
* Build trusted relationships with industry peers, partners, and relevant information-sharing communities.

Build the team and program
  

* Hire, develop, and retain a diverse, high-performing team. Create clear career paths and a healthy operating environment for people doing demanding work.
* Set a multi-year roadmap, operating budget, and investment priorities aligned with business risk and technology strategy.
* Define meaningful measures of effectiveness, such as detection coverage and validation, telemetry health, alert quality, time to detect and contain, and completion of post-incident improvements.
* Communicate security operations performance, material risks, and investment tradeoffs clearly to technical teams and executive leaders.
* Work with security and technology partners to meet applicable regulatory and contractual obligations, and provide evidence of operational effectiveness.

**About the role:**

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner. 

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. 

**This role is open to candidates residing in Canada.**

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:**
  Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

  Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams.   Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
* **You are the architect of your own career:**
  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
* **You want to be with the best:**
  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

**In this role, you will:**

* Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
* Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value.
* Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals.
* Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products.
* Support French-speaking customers implementations.
* Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
* Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

**Minimum requirements for this role:**

* 2 - 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. SaaS experience preferred.
* This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
* English and French fluency.
* Customer travel is expected. Up to 0-15%.
* Experience supporting or working with technical products.
* Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
* Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
* Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
* Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
* Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
* Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.
* Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment.
* French Fluency is a plus.

**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success team. The ideal candidate will have experience in account management, customer retention, and upselling, preferably within the financial advisor’s industry. This role is integral to supporting and managing an assigned group of customers, ensuring they achieve value from our solutions while maintaining attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy.
  
  
Our customers run highly varied CRM implementations with different account structures, operational processes, and billing arrangements. No two accounts are alike, so success in this role means tailoring your approach to each customer while staying organized across a portfolio of accounts.
  
  
**Who You’ll Support**
Maximizer serves customers across many industries, with a growing focus on financial services: wealth advisors and managers, insurance advisors, and dually licensed advisors practicing both.
  
  
You’ll manage a portfolio of customer relationships ranging from small independent teams to enterprise organizations with many teams operating under a single head office. Some of these head-office relationships span many individual accounts, so the role calls for managing both breadth and structural complexity.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of accounts, focusing on building and maintaining strong customer relationships.
* Support and manage an assigned Book of Business, ensuring satisfaction, engagement, and retention.
* Manage a diverse portfolio of customers with varied implementations, account structures, and billing arrangements, adapting your approach to each customer’s unique setup and needs.
* Keep clear, up-to-date records of key customer interactions, commitments, and follow-ups, so no promise falls through the cracks and any teammate can step in seamlessly when needed.
* Triage and prioritize competing customer needs across accounts of varying complexity, making sound judgment calls on what moves first.
* Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities to maximize account growth and customer lifetime value.
* Own multi-step issue resolution across Support, Product, Billing, and Sales, driving each item through to closure and keeping customers informed along the way.
* Conduct regular account business reviews or scheduled touch points depending on the account size and strategic importance.
* Ensure all account-related processes are executed with precision, maintaining data accuracy and process integrity within our systems.
* Contribute to the development and execution of customer engagement strategies, including the promotion of webinars, training sessions, and targeted campaigns.

**What Success Looks Like**
By the end of your first 90 days, you will have:
  
  

* Established a baseline standard of service and responsiveness across your book of business.
* Built a proactive engagement structure for every key account, scaled from complex to simple based on each account’s needs, so every key account has planned touchpoints alongside reliable coverage for incoming requests and upcoming renewals.

Beyond your first 90 days, you’ll help shape what success looks like. You’ll work with your manager to set goals for retention, engagement cadence with key accounts, and expansion and upsell targets.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* 3+ years of experience in customer account management, preferably in the financial advisors or related industry.
* Demonstrated aptitude for strategic account management, with a track record of driving customer success and retention, within the enterprise customers.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and accounts simultaneously.
* Exceptional organization and task management: you track every follow-up, deadline, and commitment, and you deliver on them.
* Strong prioritization skills with a proven ability to juggle many customer priorities at once.
* Outstanding knowledge retention: you build and maintain a deep understanding of each customer’s setup, history, and goals.
* Adaptability and nimbleness in switching between customers with very different needs, configurations, and levels of complexity.
* Technical aptitude to learn and support complex business software, and to understand how each customer has shaped it around their own processes.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Experience using CRM tools and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

**Tools you’ll use**
Zendesk, Amplitude, Metabase, Microsoft 365 (including Teams and Outlook), and Claude. Previous experience with any of these is a plus.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Fluency in both French and English (verbal and written).
* Previous experience working in a financial advisors related industry
* Familiarity with subscription-based business models and customer success metrics (e.g., renewal rates, NRR, expansion ARR).
* Experience in a SaaS company is a plus

It also drives adoption of our supply-side digital tools by vendors and drivers: Fatima, Loadboard and the vendor invoicing module. Key account management is out of scope.

**Key responsibilities:**

1. Demand fulfilment and fleet operations

● Deliver 100% fulfilment: every confirmed client demand across stations placed on time, with the right truck type.

● Run the daily demand-versus-deployment review with station supervisors; escalate shortfalls the same day.

● Track placement, transit, detention and turnaround per order; act on delays before they reach the client.

● Balance fleet across stations and lanes, including dedicated and wet-lease fleets.

**2. Sourcing, vendor management and margins**

● Lead the Vendor desk to procure trucks at the best buying rates and protect target margins on every lane under the aggregator model.

● Track margin by lane, client and vendor; flag and fix lanes running below target.

● Acquire new supply: onboard transporters, owner-operators and drivers to add fleet size and truck types, and deepen coverage on main lanes so no load goes unplaced.

● Open unexplored lanes: build supply where we have little or no coverage, and explore new kinds of supply, so new client demand can be accepted.

● Oversee vendor onboarding, documents, rate agreements and performance reviews.

● Look after vendor welfare: grievances, payment delays and long-term relationships with key transporters.

**3. POD, aging and collections**

● Through the sourcing and vendor team, ensure PODs are collected, checked and submitted on time for every trip.

● Track POD aging by station and vendor; act on over-aged PODs before they block billing.

● Link vendor payments to clean, on-time PODs.

● Work with finance ops to clear unbilled orders and support collections.

**4. Safety, insurance and damage cases**

● Work with the Safety Officer to meet each client's safety requirements, including inspections at client implant sites.

● Ensure safety procedures, audits and incident reporting are followed; close non-compliances with vendors and drivers.

● Own insurance and damage cases: register each case (order ID, truck, driver, supplier, impact, days pending), make sure an insurance case number is raised, and chase insurer, legal and supplier to closure.

**5. Supply-side AI and digital adoption**

● Driver and vendor chatbot: roll out to all drivers and vendors; drive daily active use for trip updates and queries.

● Bidding platform: onboard vendors, drivers and suppliers; move load allocation to bidding to widen supply and improve buying rates.

● Vendor invoicing module: get vendors raising invoices in the module for faster payment; reduce manual invoices.

● Report adoption weekly and feed issues back to Product and Tech. 6. Follow-up and reporting to the Head

● Maintain one tracker of open operations actions by owner, station and days pending; chase until closed.

● Prepare a daily operations brief for the Head of Operations.

**Job Description Summary**

We're hiring a Service Delivery Manager to lead service delivery for our Eng Labs Deployment and Networking function. This team owns the full lifecycle of engineering lab infrastructure changes, including lab moves, equipment adds, configuration changes, and decommissions, along with the network incident support and field coordination that keeps those labs operational.

The ideal candidate has hands-on exposure to network infrastructure deployment and lab or data center operations, and combines that technical background with proven experience as a Service Delivery Manager.

**Location:**
Fremont, CA or Menlo Park

**What You'll Do**

Service Delivery & Client Management

* Manage the Field Services, Network Operations Center, Network Deployment, and Lab Manager/Automations teams within Eng Labs, each of which owns its own scope, ensuring the team is delivering against its goals while working effectively across the other functions.
* Build and maintain working relationships with client stakeholders, flexing to meet client needs while keeping contracted scope and available resources in view.
* Escalate and manage risk proactively, surfacing issues before they become client-facing problems.

ITSM Process Ownership

* Apply ITIL-aligned practices across the service lifecycle, with direct working knowledge of:
* Incident Management: driving timely restoration of service and clear communication during active incidents
* Problem Management: identifying root cause and driving corrective/preventive action to reduce recurrence
* Knowledge Management: ensuring runbooks, SOPs, and lessons-learned are captured and kept current
* Data Management: maintaining accurate operational and asset data as the foundation for reporting and decision-making

Performance & Data Management

* Own or support the metrics that matter for the team's services, including SLAs/KPIs, ticket trends, cycle times, and quality indicators.
* Translate a desired outcome, such as reducing mean time to resolve or improving first-time-fix rate, into a scalable process or workflow that reliably moves the metric, not just a one-time fix.
* Use dashboards and operational data to identify trends, staffing/coverage gaps, and process breakdowns before they impact the client.
* Partner with tooling/platform owners to ensure data captured in operational systems is clean, complete, and usable for reporting.

People Leadership

* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance feedback to a team of technicians/engineers.
* Support scheduling, coverage planning, and workload balancing across shifts or sites.
* Onboard new team members and reinforce consistent process adherence.

**What We're Looking For**

Required

* Experience delivering managed services for clients.
* Working familiarity with ITIL methodologies, with particular focus on Incident Management and Data Management.
* 3–5 years of direct people leadership experience, with a proven track record of managing a team.
* Comfortable working with performance data across ITSM tools, ticketing platforms, and reporting dashboards, with the ability to interpret metrics and translate them into action.
* Strong client-facing communication skills, able to represent the team credibly in front of client stakeholders.
* A foundational understanding of network infrastructure (routers, switches, access points) in lab or data center environments.

Preferred

* Experience managing lab or data center Move/Add/Change/Decommission (MACD) processes or similar deployment lifecycles.
* Familiarity with IPAM systems, network asset management tools, and network equipment provisioning.
* ITIL Foundation certification, or equivalent hands-on experience in lieu of certification.
* Experience building or improving a repeatable process from scratch, not just following an existing one.
* Prior experience in a staffing, managed services, or outsourced operations company.

* Set up practical account governance, including meeting cadence, reporting, escalation paths, roles, responsibilities, and decision processes.
* Coordinate with technical, service desk, security, consulting, vendor, and leadership teams to keep work moving and handoffs clear.

The role
  
  
Our clients count on Ark for reliable, well-run service, and this role makes sure that happens. What you'll do
  
  
Service management for assigned clients
  
  

* Follow Ark's Case, Request, Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for assigned clients, and give feedback to improve them in line with ITIL best practices.
